suggestions.reason: Test URLs are fictional 404s. This assertion can never pass with non-existent pages. The skill correctly identified the 404s and refused — this is actually good behavior. Consider using real, accessible URLs for eval 1.
No assertion checks whether the skill correctly identifies and reports 404 status — a critical capability that was well demonstrated here.
No assertion checks quality of strategic alternatives proposed when outreach is not recommended — the with_skill output provided 4 concrete alternatives.

eval_feedback.overall: 4 of 8 assertions failed due to test URLs being 404, not due to skill deficiency. The skill behaved correctly by refusing outreach on dead pages. Assertions need real URLs to test the positive path.
